content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD sample wave-condition generators (BSD header L12-L55): seven external subroutines providing boundary/initial conditions selected via input.txt keys. (1) SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY (L67-L90, key 'SOL' @L61): on the west-boundary rank only (n_west==MPI_PROC_NULL @L73) imposes a Boussinesq solitary-wave surface at column Ibeg using aa=AMP_SOLI, h00=DEP_SOLI, celerity c1=sqrt(GRAV*h00*(1.0_SP+aa/h00)) @L77, decay tex=sqrt(0.75_SP*aa/h00**3) @L79, zz=aa/COSH(tex*(Lag_soli-c1*TIME))**2 @L81, setting Eta and H=Eta+Depth (L82-L83); comment @L84 'can not provide u and hu at boundary for dispersive equations' with U/HU lines commented (L85-L86). (2) INITIAL_WAVE (L102-L162, key 'INI' @L96): computes local XX,YY grids (L111-L116) and defines box (L127-L133), dam-break (L139-L143), commented Gaussian (L146-L147) and alongshore-crest (L153-L159) initializations — but every branch is skipped by unconditional GOTOs (goto 200 @L125, goto 100 @L137, goto 213 @L152), so as compiled the subroutine modifies nothing. (3) INITIAL_RECTANGULAR(M,N,Nghost,DX,DY,Xc,Yc,WID,AMP,Eta) (L174-L206, key 'INI_REC' @L168): Eta=ZERO then sets Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr)=AMP @L203 where Il=Nghost+Xc/DX-WID/DX+1-(iista-1) etc. (L191-L194, ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacing npx*Mglob/px offsets L187-L190), clipped to the local block (L197-L202). (4) INITIAL_GAUSIAN(M,N,Nghost,DX,DY,Xc,Yc,AMP,WID,Eta) (L218-L245): Gaussian hump Eta=AMP*EXP(-r**2/1.0_SP/WID**2) @L240 with global coordinates xr=(I-1)*DX-Nghost*DX+(iista-1)*DX @L236, r @L239. (5) INITIAL_DIPOLE (L257-L285, key 'INI_DIP' @L251): dipole Eta=AMP*uni*EXP(-r**2/1.0_SP/WID**2+0.5_SP) @L280 with uni=-1.414_SP/WID*(xr-Xc) @L279. (6) INITIAL_N_WAVE(M,N,DX,x1,x2,Ha,gamma_s,dep,U,V,Eta) (L297-L335, key N_WAVE @L291): silent STOP if dep==ZERO (L307-L310); dimensional Tadepalli-Synolakis coefficients a0=3.0_SP*SQRT(3.0_SP)*Ha/2.0_SP @L314, gamma=3.0_SP*0.5_SP/dep*SQRT(SQRT(3.0_SP/4.0_SP)*Ha/dep) @L315 (comments cite 'Synolakis etal (A15)' and 'xi zhao etal icce 2010' L311-L313); isosceles N-wave Eta=a0*COSH(gamma*(tmp1-x1))**(-2)*tanh(gamma*(tmp1-x1)) @L328 (general form commented @L326), U=SQRT(GRAV/dep)*Eta @L329, V=ZERO @L330. (7) INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE(M,N,DX,Xwavemaker,AMP_Soli,Dep_Soli,Beta,U,V,Eta,SolitaryPositiveDirection) (L347-L386, key SOL @L341): hardcodes alpha=-0.39 @L364 (formula alpha=0.5*Beta*Beta+Beta commented @L361 with note L362-L363 'something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39'); CALLs SUB_SLTRY @L366 for coefficients; profile SC=1.0_SP/COSH(B*((iista-1)+I-Xwavemaker/DX-1)*DX) @L373, Eta=A1*SC**2+A2*SC**4 @L375, U=+/-A*SC*SC by direction flag (L376-L380), V=ZERO. (8) SUB_SLTRY(a0,h1,alp,r1,bue,ae1,ae2,au,C_ph) (L397-L449): solitary-wave solution 'of Nogu equations' @L391 — builds cubic x**3+p*x**2+q*x+r=0 (comment L406-L407) with alp2=alp+1.0_SP/3.0_SP @L409, eps=a0/h1 @L410, p @L413, q @L414, r @L415; Newton-Raphson from x=1.2_SP @L419 (fx @L420, fpx @L421, x=x-fx/fpx @L422, max 10 iterations then silent stop L425-L428, tolerance 1e-5 @L429); outputs celerity r1=C_ph=rx*cph=sqrt(x)*sqrt(g*h1) (L430-L433) and profile coefficients au @L442, bue @L443, ae1 @L444, ae2 @L445-L446 for u=au/cosh^2, eta=ae1/cosh^2+ae2/cosh^4 (comment L438-L440).

verbatim_spans.text: ! note: can not provide u and hu at boundary for dispersive equations!
! something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39
!    SUB_SLTRY is subroutine to provide solitary wave solution of Nogu equations

unresolved: INITIAL_WAVE is entirely dead code as compiled: goto 200 @L125 jumps past the box block (L127-L133), goto 100 @L137 past the dam-break block (L139-L143), goto 213 @L152 past the alongshore-crest block (L153-L159), and the Gaussian is commented (L146-L147) — the subroutine leaves Eta untouched though input key 'INI' selects it (cross-line L125/L137/L152)

INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE hardcodes alpha=-0.39 @L364; comments L361-L363 record that the formula 0.5*Beta*Beta+Beta with beta=-0.531 'should be' -0.39 but 'the solitary wave shape does not match the equation. but alpha = -0.10 seems OK' — the discrepancy is documented, not resolved; dummy argument Beta @L355 is consequently unused
Both STOP paths are silent (L309 with message commented @L308; L427 with message commented @L426) — failure cause is not reported at runtime

SUB_SLTRY: zr @L447 is computed but never used; r1 and C_ph are duplicates (L432-L433); au @L442 contains eps in both numerator and denominator (cancels); header @L391 cites 'Nogu equations' (spelling; likely Nwogu)
INITIAL_GAUSIAN's header @L212 says key 'INI_REC' (copy-paste from INITIAL_RECTANGULAR); actual key for Gaussian is not stated in this file
SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY: tex/tlag are recomputed inside the J loop though loop-invariant (L79-L80) and tlag is never used; boundary applies Eta/H only at the single column Ibeg on west-edge ranks

Loop indices i,j,I,J and scratch tmp1,tmp2 are the PARAM module shared variables (no local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE); XX,YY @L105 are computed (L111-L116) but used only by the commented Gaussian lines (L146-L147); locals sigma,x_c,y_c,a @L118-L121 and ii1,ii2 @L153-L154 belong to dead code; Il,Jl,Ir,Jr declared unused in INITIAL_GAUSIAN @L226 and INITIAL_DIPOLE @L265; gamma_s dummy @L303 unused
INITIAL_DIPOLE literal 1.414_SP (approx sqrt(2)) @L279 and the +0.5_SP exponent offset @L280 are not explained in the file
